question: There are 359000 people in a district out of which 179000 are males. If 22% of the total population is literate and 22% of males are literate, then what is the percentage literacy rate of females?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The overall literacy rate is given as 22%, and the male literacy rate is also 22%.

According to the weighted average concept, if a subgroup has an average identical to the overall group average, the remaining subgroup must also share the exact same average.

Since the male literacy matches the overall literacy, the female literacy rate must naturally be equal to the overall average without any calculation.

**∴ The correct answer is 22%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total population = 359,000

Total males = 179,000

⇒ Total females = Total population − Total males = 359,000 − 179,000 = 180,000

Overall literacy rate = 22%

Male literacy rate = 22%

**Formula Used:**

Total literate people = Literate males + Literate females

 
 Males: 22%

 
 Females: x%

 
 Overall: 22%

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 x − 22
 0

 Population Ratio → 179 : 180

**Calculations:**

Let the literacy rate of females be x%.

⇒ 22% of 359,000 = (22% of 179,000) + (x% of 180,000)

⇒ (22 ÷ 100) × 359000 = (22 ÷ 100) × 179000 + (x ÷ 100) × 180000

Multiplying the entire equation by 100 to remove fractions:

⇒ 22 × 359000 = 22 × 179000 + x × 180000

⇒ 22 × 359000 − 22 × 179000 = x × 180000

⇒ 22 × (359000 − 179000) = x × 180000

⇒ 22 × 180000 = x × 180000

⇒ x = (22 × 180000) ÷ 180000

⇒ x = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Property

When a group is divided into two or more parts and one part has the same average as the overall average, the remaining parts must also have an average identical to the overall average.

Rule of Alligation

It is used to find the ratio in which two groups with different averages are mixed to obtain an overall average. Formula: (Quantity 1 ÷ Quantity 2) = (Average 2 − Overall Average) ÷ (Overall Average − Average 1).

Percentage Basics

Percentage literally means "per hundred". It is a fraction with a denominator of 100. To find a percentage of any quantity: Value = (Percentage × Total Base) ÷ 100.
